# linux_sed (Data Source)

Runs `sed` expressions on a file without changing it: tells whether they would change the file, and what it would become. To test whether a file contains a line, `regexall` on the content of the `linux_file` data source also works.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_sed" "root_login" {
  path        = "/etc/ssh/sshd_config"
  expressions = ["s/^#?PermitRootLogin .*/PermitRootLogin no/"]
  extended    = true
}

output "root_login_needs_change" {
  value = data.linux_sed.root_login.pending
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expressions` (List of String) `sed` expressions, each passed with `-e`.
- `path` (String) Absolute path of the file.

### Optional

- `extended` (Boolean) Use extended regular expressions (`sed -E`). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Path of the file.
- `pending` (Boolean) Whether applying the expressions would change the file.
- `result` (String) Content of the file after applying the expressions.
